artifact_observations.location: Front cover central graphics and spine text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine ('...O CIO'?) and the elaborate script on the cover are nonsensical and illegible. This is a classic AI artifact where the model mimics the structure of text without generating valid characters.
The line drawings on the cover have a 'sketchy' or 'melting' quality, lacking the crisp vector lines usually found on manufactured binder covers. They blend slightly into the pink background.
The top edge shows slight waviness and inconsistent thickness, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation of the rigid box shape.
